articles.title: Winning hearts in an age of infinite travel choices
articles.summary: Travelers’ discovery and booking journeys have been reshaped. How can travel players show up at every turn on the path from search to certainty?

articles.title: The economics of AI
articles.summary: AI is getting more expensive for companies. As rising token usage and workflow complexity make costs harder to predict, leaders need new ways to manage AI economics.

articles.title: WIRED: The AI playbook top companies use
articles.summary: McKinsey’s Dan Swan explains why capturing AI’s full potential requires companies to move beyond experimentation and fundamentally rewire their businesses across technology, processes, people, and leadership.

articles.title: Novartis’s Christian Diehl on scaling AI beyond the demo
articles.summary: Novartis’s chief data and digital officer for biomedical research explains how data platform investments are paying off in AI safety prediction, generative chemistry, and faster translation.

articles.title: AI drug discovery: Focusing on what matters most
articles.summary: AI is accelerating drug discovery, but investment has concentrated in molecule design—the stage with the best data and clearest tools. The industry’s real constraint lies elsewhere: identifying and validating the right disease mechanism.
